summary: EvalScope judge prompt was built by sequential replace, so a model answer containing {gold} pulled the reference answer into the predicted-answer section (ETB-02)
details:
Issue #1697 reported four scoring defects in EvalScope at commit 3c52bd0, as a follow-up to #1578. This record covers the first. `LLMJudge.build_prompt` in `evalscope/metrics/judge/llm_judge.py` filled `{question}`, `{pred}` and `{gold}` with one `str.replace` after another over the whole prompt. A model answer that contained the literal text `{gold}` had the reference answer substituted into the predicted-answer section. The issue reports a wrong answer scoring 1.0 this way. This is ETB-02 (unsanitized model output in the evaluator prompt): text the evaluated model wrote was read again as a template placeholder.

The other three defects were fixed in the same pull request and have no registry record. A failed metric was recorded as a successful zero. The `general_arena` bootstrap confidence bounds depended on the global random state. `Accuracy` with `allow_inclusion` graded with Python `in`, so list and string references were matched by different rules.

Fix: pull request #1702, written by another contributor (opened 2026-09-04, merged 2026-09-07, first released in evalscope 1.12.0 on 2026-09-16), renders the three placeholders in one pass over the original template, so inserted questions, predictions and references stay literal. The pull request also changes score-cache identities.

database_specific.note: 'introduced: 0' is a conservative bound; the issue pins commit 3c52bd0. Git tag v1.11.1 does not contain the fix commit and tag v1.12.0 does (GitHub compare, 2026-11-12). PyPI lists 1.12.0, uploaded 2026-09-16.

attack.description: The evaluated model includes the literal text `{gold}` in its answer. The judge prompt is built by replacing `{pred}` first and `{gold}` afterwards, so the reference answer is written into the predicted-answer section that the judge reads.
attack.preconditions: A benchmark graded through `LLMJudge.build_prompt` with a template that contains `{gold}`.
attack.poc_pointer: tests/metrics/test_judge_prompt_rendering.py, added by pull request #1702. The issue says the defect reproduces with offline stubs; the stubs are not on the page.

hardening.fix: Render the judge template's placeholders in a single pass so inserted text is never re-read as a placeholder.
hardening.pattern: Escape or structurally neutralize model output before it enters any grader prompt; use message-role separation (taxonomy ETB-02 fix pattern).
hardening.residual_risk: Scores cached before the fix are not reused: the pull request changes cache identities and asks for a review rerun.

disclosure.tier_reason: Public artifact, no non-public information, impact limited to benchmark scores, fixes offered with the report.
disclosure.notes: Reported as issue #1697 from the AUTHENSOR account, together with three other defects. Fixed by pull request #1702, written by another contributor; a maintainer approved and merged it on 2026-09-07.
